_comment: Synthetic tplot recording for pyspedas.dscovr.fc during the Gannon storm. np_y = proton density (cm^-3), v_y = V_GSE vector components (km/s), temp_y = thermal temperature (K). Values reflect the high-speed solar-wind transient: speed climbs from ~600 to >780 km/s, density spikes to >20 cm^-3.
